permit.first: The Ministry of Labour must first find that no Liberian is qualified for the post and that it has been duly advertised (the Civil Service Agency's 2024 report).

sources.title: Civil Service Agency (Liberia), A Report from the Analysis of the Alien Work Permit 2024 (June 2025)
sources.said: before issuing a work permit, the Ministry of Labor must have asserted that the position for which a permit is being sought: - No Liberian is qualiﬁed for it. - Has been duly advertised

note: Decent Work Act 2015, ch. 45.1, and the Revised Regulation No. 17 of 2019, as the Civil Service Agency's 2025 report and the Ministry's June 2026 notice (reported by AllAfrica) give them: no permit unless no Liberian is qualified and the post was advertised at least 30 days in two newspapers, two radio stations and two Liberian websites including the Ministry's. The ordinary permit fee rose from US$1,000 to US$3,000 in 2025 by the Ministry's administrative decision (press, quoting the Finance Minister and a Senate committee); the Ministry's own fee schedule was not read (mol.gov.lr not reached). ECOWAS citizens work as nationals do (layer 3's ecowas list).
